# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical AI ground rules, along with [AGENT_NOTES.md](../AGENT_NOTES.md) and [the project brief](../docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md).

Keep changes scoped to the assigned task, preserve teammates' work, protect secrets, and report only checks actually run. Human review is required before merges or releases. The idea and stack are not chosen; do not invent an application or build commands. The current repository check is `python3 scripts/check_repo.py`; application builds and tests must be added with the chosen stack.
